event:capacity_and_network.label: Network expansion with new routes
event:capacity_and_network.note: The summer programme featured a large number of routes, including new routes to leisure destinations, and the winter season operated routes to many destinations. Quote (page 3): "Norwegian’s summer 2025 programme featured nearly 350 routes, including 17 new routes to attractive leisure destinations."

event:capital_returns.label: Dividend paid to shareholders
event:capital_returns.note: The company paid a dividend to its shareholders in August. Quote (page 6): "In 2025, the company paid its first-ever dividend, distributing NOK 0.90 per share to its nearly 75,000 shareholders in August."

event:fleet_and_engines.label: Purchase of previously leased aircraft
event:fleet_and_engines.note: Norwegian acquired previously leased Boeing 737-800 aircraft, which contributed accounting gains and recurring cost savings. Quote (page 3): "Norwegian's acquisition of 13 previously leased Boeing 737-800 aircraft contributed to accounting gains in 2025 and recurring cost savings, further strengthening our financial position."

event:fleet_and_engines-2.label: Option exercised for additional 737 MAX 8 aircraft
event:fleet_and_engines-2.note: The company exercised its option to purchase additional Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft on top of its previous order. Quote (page 3): "We also exercised our option to purchase 30 additional Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft, adding to the previous 50 aircraft order, reinforcing our commitment to a modern and fuel-efficient fleet."

event:funding_and_rating.label: Redemption and buy-back of convertible bonds
event:funding_and_rating.note: Norwegian announced it would redeem all outstanding New Capital Perpetual Bonds and launched an offer to repurchase part of them, after which the bonds were redeemed in full. Quote (page 20): "During the second quarter of 2025, Norwegian announced that it would exercise its call option to redeem all outstanding New Capital Perpetual Bonds bonds, totalling NOK 1,501 million, and that the company would launch an offer to repurchase up to 50 percent of these bonds. Following these transactions, the convertible bonds were redeemed in full."

event:labour.label: New collective bargaining agreements with unions
event:labour.note: The company negotiated several new collective bargaining agreements with its unions covering pilots, cabin crew and technicians. Quote (page 4): "During the year, we successfully negotiated several new collective bargaining agreements with our unions, securing fair conditions for our pilots, cabin crew, and technicians across the group."
